accounts.name: APEX 50K · intraday trailing
accounts.notes: Apex 4.0 rules (accounts bought from March 2026). The floor follows the unrealized high and locks at $50,100. No daily loss limit or minimum days; 30 days to pass.

accounts.name: APEX 50K · end-of-day trailing
accounts.notes: Apex 4.0 rules. The floor is recalculated at the close (4:59:59 PM ET). $1,000 daily loss limit (including unrealized): it closes positions and pauses the day, it does not fail the account. The help center is not clear on where the floor stops rising: $50,100 is assumed.

accounts.name: APEX 50K · legacy (before Mar 2026)
accounts.notes: Accounts bought before March 2026: $2,500 intraday trailing drawdown that locks at $50,100.

accounts.name: Lucid 50K Flex
accounts.notes: End-of-day trailing. Your best day cannot exceed 40% of total profit (if it does, you keep trading), which means passing takes at least 3 days. With an optional add-on chosen at purchase (it can't be changed afterwards), the limit is 50% and you can pass in 2 days. Optional daily loss limit at purchase (not included here). Lucid, read on Oct 27, 2026.

accounts.name: Lucid 50K Pro
accounts.notes: End-of-day trailing. Fixed $1,200 daily loss limit (it ends the day, it does not fail the account). No consistency rule in the evaluation; you can pass in 1 day.

accounts.name: Tradeify 50K Select
accounts.notes: Tradeify help center (Oct 16, 2026): $3,000 target ($2,500 on accounts bought before the new dashboard), $2,000 end-of-day drawdown enforced in real time, no daily loss limit in the evaluation and a 40% consistency rule (3 days minimum). Where the floor stops rising is not clear in the help center: starting balance + $100 is assumed.

accounts.name: Topstep 50K Trading Combine
accounts.notes: Topstep help center (Oct 16, 2026): $2,000 maximum loss limit that rises at each day's close and locks at the starting balance; monitored in real time. $1,000 daily loss limit (Responsible Trading Program: ends the session, does not fail the account). Consistency: best day at most 55% of the target; if exceeded, the target rises.

accounts.name: MyFundedFutures 50K Pro
accounts.notes: Pro plan, checked Oct 22, 2026. Open losses count in real time, and if you go 7 calendar days in a row without trading the account can be closed. Where the floor stops: its end-of-day drawdown article says at $50,100 (what we simulate); the Pro plan page says it keeps trailing until the first payout. Ask before you buy. Rapid EOD uses 30% consistency and 4 minimum days.
